entries.title: Job 24:1
segments: ¶"[Since] times are not hidden from the Almighty, Why do those who know Him see not His days?

entries.title: Job 24:2
segments: "[Some] remove landmarks; They seize flocks violently and feed [on them];

entries.title: Job 24:3
segments: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless; They take the widow's ox as a pledge.

entries.title: Job 24:4
segments: They push the needy off the road; All the poor of the land are forced to hide.

entries.title: Job 24:5
segments: Indeed, [like] wild donkeys in the desert, They go out to their work, searching for food. The wilderness [yields] food for them [and] for [their] children.

entries.title: Job 24:6
segments: They gather their fodder in the field And glean in the vineyard of the wicked.

entries.title: Job 24:7
segments: They spend the night naked, without clothing, And have no covering in the cold.

entries.title: Job 24:8
segments: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, And huddle around the rock for want of shelter.

entries.title: Job 24:9
segments: "[Some] snatch the fatherless from the breast, And take a pledge from the poor.

entries.title: Job 24:10
segments: They cause [the poor] to go naked, without clothing; And they take away the sheaves from the hungry.

entries.title: Job 24:11
segments: They press out oil within their walls, And tread winepresses, yet suffer thirst.

entries.title: Job 24:12
segments: The dying groan in the city, And the souls of the wounded cry out; Yet God does not charge [them] with wrong.

entries.title: Job 24:13
segments: ¶"There are those who rebel against the light; They do not know its ways Nor abide in its paths.

entries.title: Job 24:14
segments: The murderer rises with the light; He kills the poor and needy; And in the night he is like a thief.

entries.title: Job 24:15
segments: The eye of the adulterer waits for the twilight, Saying, 'No eye will see me'; And he disguises [his] face.

entries.title: Job 24:16
segments: In the dark they break into houses Which they marked for themselves in the daytime; They do not know the light.

entries.title: Job 24:17
segments: For the morning is the same to them as the shadow of death; If [someone] recognizes [them, They are in] the terrors of the shadow of death.

entries.title: Job 24:18
segments: ¶"They [should be] swift on the face of the waters, Their portion [should be] cursed in the earth, [So that] no [one would] turn into the way of their vineyards.

entries.title: Job 24:19
segments: As drought and heat consume the snow waters, [So] the grave [consumes those who] have sinned.

entries.title: Job 24:20
segments: The womb [should] forget him, The worm [should] feed sweetly on him; He [should] be remembered no more, And wickedness [should] be broken like a tree.

entries.title: Job 24:21
segments: For he preys on the barren [who] do not bear, And does no good for the widow.

entries.title: Job 24:22
segments: "But God draws the mighty away with His power; He rises up, but no [man] is sure of life.

entries.title: Job 24:23
segments: He gives them security, and they rely [on it]; Yet His eyes [are] on their ways.

entries.title: Job 24:24
segments: They are exalted for a little while, Then they are gone. They are brought low; They are taken out of the way like all [others]; They dry out like the heads of grain.

entries.title: Job 24:25
segments: "Now if [it is] not [so], who will prove me a liar, And make my speech worth nothing?"
